en: Black‑and‑white street view of a European town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century houses lining both sides of a wide road. The right side features large multi‑story residential blocks with ornate gabled facades; the left side has smaller townhouses and fenced front yards. A horse‑drawn delivery cart with advertising on its side travels down the street while several children walk or play nearby. Wooden picket fences, telegraph/telephone poles, and cobbled or packed roadway are visible. The image has the framing, perspective, and subject typical of an early 20th‑century urban postcard.
